title: Contractible representable evaluations compute derived colimits, with reindexing naturality
statement: Fix universes as in [def-weil-size-convention]. Let $\mathcal D$ be a small ordinary category in the working universe, let $R$ be a commutative ring, and let $F:\mathcal D\to\operatorname{Mod}_R$ be a covariant functor. Write $\mathbf H(\mathcal D,F)=\mathbf L\operatorname{colim}_{\mathcal D}F\in D(R)$, where the left derived colimit is computed from projective resolutions in the abelian functor category and derived categories mean [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. Let $Q:\Delta^{\mathrm{op}}\to\mathcal D$ be a simplicial object [def-weil-pbc-simplicial-object] such that for every $T\in\mathcal D$ the simplicial set $\operatorname{Hom}_{\mathcal D}(T,Q_\bullet)$ is homotopy equivalent to a singleton. Put $s(F(Q))^{-n}=F(Q_n)$ with differential $\sum_i(-1)^iF(d_i)$, and zero terms in positive degrees. There is a canonical isomorphism $a_Q:s(F(Q))\xrightarrow{\sim}\mathbf H(\mathcal D,F)$, natural in $F$ and in $Q$. More precisely, the latter object has the bar-complex model with degree $-n$ equal to $\bigoplus_{T_0\to\cdots\to T_n}F(T_0)$, whose faces delete a vertex, applying $F$ to the first arrow for the first face. For a functor $u:\mathcal D\to\mathcal D'$, a ring map $\rho:R\to R'$, and a natural transformation $\theta:F\to\operatorname{Res}_\rho(F'\circ u)$, these bar complexes give a canonical map $\mathbf H(u,\theta):\mathbf H(\mathcal D,F)\to\operatorname{Res}_\rho\mathbf H(\mathcal D',F')$ by $(T_0\to\cdots\to T_n,x)\mapsto(uT_0\to\cdots\to uT_n,\theta_{T_0}(x))$. It preserves identities and composition. If $Q'$ satisfies the same contractibility hypothesis in $\mathcal D'$ and $k:uQ\to Q'$ is a simplicial morphism, then $a_{Q'}\circ s(F'(k)\circ\theta_Q)=\mathbf H(u,\theta)\circ a_Q$ in $D(R)$, with restriction of scalars on all target objects. No contractibility assumption on $uQ$ is required. Restriction of scalars in this formula is degreewise restriction on the displayed bar complexes, hence is compatible with their comparison isomorphisms.

source.place: Tag 08Q9 (lemma-compute-by-cosimplicial-resolution), applied to C=D^op; Tags 08PG (example-left-derived-colimits) and 08PH (example-morphism-categories), and Tag 08PD (remark-morphism-fibred-categories). The bar-complex formulas give the stated naturality, also under restriction of coefficient scalars.
